source.text: Erik Balling( 29 November 1924 – 19 November 2005) was a Danish TV and film director. He created two of Denmark's most popular TV- series," Matador" and" Huset på Christianshavn". His feature film" Qivitoq"( 1956) was nominated for a Golden Palm at the 1957 Cannes Film Festival, and for an Oscar as Best Foreign Language Film. His 1962 film" Den kære familie" was entered into the 3rd Moscow International Film Festival. Together with Henning Bahs, he also created the hugely popular series of" Olsen Gang" feature films.
source.title: Erik Balling
